name: commit-condom
description: A policy-enforcing git push gate: the agent holds a placeholder token, the proxy holds the real PAT, and every push is checked for chunk size, file count, message format and session budget before it reaches GitHub.

scripts.test: GIT_TEMPLATE_DIR=/tmp/opencode/no-hooks CC_NO_MACHINE_POLICY=1 node test/policy.test.js && GIT_TEMPLATE_DIR=/tmp/opencode/no-hooks node test/proxy.test.js && GIT_TEMPLATE_DIR=/tmp/opencode/no-hooks node test/mcp.test.js && node test/wire.test.js && GIT_TEMPLATE_DIR=/tmp/opencode/no-hooks node test/inescapable.test.js && GIT_TEMPLATE_DIR=/tmp/opencode/no-hooks CC_NO_MACHINE_POLICY=1 node test/newrepo.test.js
scripts.check: node --check src/policy.js && node --check src/proxy.js && node --check src/config.js && node --check bin/cc.js && node --check bin/cc-proxy.js && node --check mcp/server.js
